summary: Contribution by Kristian Muri Knausgård. Policy v2 (RH foundation). The reflected certificate of knausgard-rh-reflected-bhb-78 with a new kernel in the explicit formula: the multiplicity bound uses the normalised autocorrelation of Ψ(u) = 1 − (2u/h)²/5 instead of the Fejér kernel, so m(ρ) ≤ w(0) − 2 Re W(ρ) with a degree-5 polynomial weight w. The high prime band, strip and tail of the 85.39 proof are re-proved for this weight; the mollifier (P(v) = 1.78v − 0.78v²), the low band and the short prime sum are unchanged. This yields N_d ≥ (0.854225 − o(1))N on (T, 2T] and (0, T]. The new modules fork modules of knausgard-rh-reflected-bhb-78; the formal 19/27 development comes from knausgard-rh-bui-heath-brown-deg40.
method: Reflected mixed-moment certificate with an optimised explicit-formula kernel (autocorrelation of 1−(2u/h)²/5) in place of Fejér's; BHB mollifier P(v) = 1.78v−0.78v².
